Esports Helper 0.1.2 adds more control over Dashboard matches and color rules.

- Open Dashboard matches in new tabs using the gray button, Ctrl/Cmd-click, or middle-click, including role-specific Dashboard pages.
- Reverse Past match days so the most recent day appears first, preserving the match order within each day.
- Drag color rules to reorder them. Place specific Season rules such as JV Rocket League above general Game rules. The first matching rule wins.
- Only match coloring and chat links are enabled by default. Existing saved preferences are preserved.

Validation: JavaScript syntax, manifest and asset checks, and Chromium fixture tests.

[Get the Esports Helper extension!](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/ijoihdmdnameopfehjlbcjlbpmebknfe)

The attached ZIP contains runtime files only. Publishing this GitHub release does not submit or publish a Chrome Web Store update.
